title: Password Reset Guide
content:
CloudDesk Password Reset Guide

How to Reset Your Password

Step 1: Navigate to the CloudDesk login page at https://app.clouddesk.io/login.

Step 2: Click the 'Forgot Password?' link below the login form.

Step 3: Enter the email address associated with your CloudDesk account.

Step 4: Check your email inbox for a password reset link. The link expires after 60 minutes.

Step 5: Click the reset link and enter your new password. Passwords must be at least 12 characters long, contain uppercase and lowercase letters, at least one number, and one special character.

Step 6: After resetting your password, you will need to log in again on all devices. Existing sessions will be invalidated for security.

Important Notes:
- If you do not receive the reset email within 5 minutes, check your spam folder.
- If you still cannot reset your password, contact CloudDesk Support.
- After 5 failed password reset attempts, your account will be temporarily locked for 30 minutes.
- Password reset links are single-use and cannot be shared.
- Your new password cannot be the same as any of your last 5 passwords.

Two-Factor Authentication:
If you have 2FA enabled, you will need your authenticator app or backup codes after resetting your password. If you have lost access to your 2FA device, contact Support for identity verification.

title: Account Security Policy
content:
CloudDesk Account Security Policy

Account Protection

CloudDesk implements multiple layers of security to protect your account:

1. Password Requirements: Minimum 12 characters, mixed case, numbers, and special characters required.

2. Two-Factor Authentication (2FA): Available via authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy) or hardware security keys (YubiKey). SMS-based 2FA is not supported due to SIM-swapping risks.

3. Session Management: Sessions expire after 8 hours of inactivity. Active sessions can be viewed and terminated from Settings > Security > Active Sessions.

4. Login Notifications: Email notifications are sent for logins from new devices or locations.

5. Account Lockout: After 5 consecutive failed login attempts, the account is locked for 30 minutes. After 10 failed attempts within 24 hours, manual unlock by Support is required.

Suspected Unauthorized Access:
- If you suspect someone has accessed your account without permission, immediately change your password and enable 2FA.
- Contact CloudDesk Support to request an account security review.
- CloudDesk can provide a login activity log for the past 90 days.
- If unauthorized changes were made, CloudDesk can roll back account settings to a previous state.

Data Breach Protocol:
- CloudDesk monitors for credential leaks across known breach databases.
- Affected users are automatically notified and required to reset their password.
- Enterprise customers receive dedicated breach notifications through their admin portal.

title: Billing and Subscription Plans
content:
CloudDesk Billing and Subscription Plans

Available Plans:

1. Starter Plan — $12/user/month (billed annually) or $15/user/month (billed monthly)
   - Up to 10 users
   - 50 GB storage
   - Email support
   - Basic integrations

2. Professional Plan — $29/user/month (billed annually) or $35/user/month (billed monthly)
   - Up to 100 users
   - 500 GB storage
   - Priority support
   - Advanced integrations
   - Custom workflows
   - API access

3. Enterprise Plan — Custom pricing
   - Unlimited users
   - Unlimited storage
   - Dedicated support
   - SSO / SAML
   - Advanced security
   - SLA guarantee
   - Custom deployment options

Billing Cycle:
- Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period.
- Invoices are generated on the renewal date and sent to the billing contact email.
- Payment methods accepted: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and wire transfer (Enterprise only).

Failed Payments:
- If a payment fails, CloudDesk will retry the charge 3 times over 9 days (days 1, 5, and 9).
- After the third failed attempt, the account enters a 14-day grace period with limited functionality.
- During the grace period, data is preserved but new project creation is disabled.
- After the grace period, the account is suspended. Data is retained for 30 days before deletion.

Upgrades and Downgrades:
- Upgrades take effect immediately. The prorated difference is charged.
- Downgrades take effect at the next billing cycle. No partial refunds are issued for the current period.

Taxes:
- Applicable taxes (VAT, GST, sales tax) are added based on the billing address.

title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
content:
CloudDesk Cancellation and Refund Policy

Cancellation:
- You can cancel your CloudDesk subscription at any time from Settings > Billing > Cancel Subscription.
- Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. You retain access until then.
- Upon cancellation, your data will be available for export for 30 days. After 30 days, data is permanently deleted.
- To export your data before cancellation, go to Settings > Data > Export All Data.

Refunds:
- Monthly subscriptions: No refunds are issued for partial months.
- Annual subscriptions: A prorated refund is available if cancellation is requested within the first 30 days of the annual billing period. After 30 days, no refunds are issued.
- Enterprise contracts: Refund terms are governed by the individual contract.

Reactivation:
- If you cancel and wish to reactivate within 30 days, your data and settings will be restored.
- After 30 days, you will need to create a new account.

Team Impact:
- When an admin cancels a team subscription, all team members lose access at the end of the billing period.
- Team members are notified via email 7 days before access is revoked.
- Individual team members cannot cancel a team subscription; only admins have this permission.

title: API Documentation Overview
content:
CloudDesk API Documentation

Overview:
CloudDesk provides a RESTful API for programmatic access to your workspace. The API is available on Professional and Enterprise plans.

Authentication:
- API requests are authenticated using API keys.
- Generate API keys from Settings > Integrations > API Keys.
- Include the API key in the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
- API keys can be scoped to specific permissions (read, write, admin).

Rate Limits:
- Starter: Not available
- Professional: 1,000 requests per minute
- Enterprise: 10,000 requests per minute
- Rate limit headers are included in all responses: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset

Endpoints:
- GET /api/v2/projects — List all projects
- POST /api/v2/projects — Create a new project
- GET /api/v2/projects/{id} — Get project details
- PUT /api/v2/projects/{id} — Update a project
- DELETE /api/v2/projects/{id} — Delete a project
- GET /api/v2/tasks — List tasks
- POST /api/v2/tasks — Create a task
- GET /api/v2/users — List workspace members
- POST /api/v2/webhooks — Register a webhook

Webhooks:
- CloudDesk supports webhooks for real-time event notifications.
- Supported events: project.created, project.updated, task.completed, member.added, member.removed
- Webhook payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256 for verification.

SDKs:
- Official SDKs are available for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Go.
- Community SDKs exist for Ruby, PHP, and Java.

Errors:
- 400 Bad Request: Invalid parameters
- 401 Unauthorized: Invalid or missing API key
- 403 Forbidden: Insufficient permissions
- 404 Not Found: Resource does not exist
- 429 Too Many Requests: Rate limit exceeded
- 500 Internal Server Error: Contact support

title: Team Management and Permissions
content:
CloudDesk Team Management

Roles:
- Owner: Full administrative control. Can manage billing, users, and workspace settings. Only one owner per workspace.
- Admin: Can manage team members, projects, and integrations. Cannot modify billing or transfer ownership.
- Member: Can create and edit projects and tasks. Cannot manage team settings.
- Guest: Read-only access to specific projects they are invited to.

Inviting Team Members:
1. Go to Settings > Team > Invite Members.
2. Enter the email addresses of the people you want to invite.
3. Select their role.
4. Click Send Invitations.
5. Invitations expire after 7 days. Resend from Settings > Team > Pending Invitations.

Removing Team Members:
- Admins and Owners can remove team members from Settings > Team.
- When a member is removed, their tasks are reassigned to the admin who removed them.
- Removed members lose access immediately.
- Their personal data is retained for 30 days for audit purposes, then deleted.

Permission Groups:
- Professional and Enterprise plans support custom permission groups.
- Create groups with specific permissions for projects, tasks, files, and integrations.
- Assign users to groups from Settings > Team > Permission Groups.

SSO/SAML:
- Enterprise plans support Single Sign-On via SAML 2.0.
- Supported providers: Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, OneLogin.
- SSO configuration is available in Settings > Security > SSO.

title: Data Export and Portability
content:
CloudDesk Data Export

Exporting Your Data:
- CloudDesk allows you to export all your workspace data at any time.
- Go to Settings > Data > Export All Data.
- Export includes: projects, tasks, comments, files, user data, and activity logs.
- Export formats: JSON, CSV, or ZIP (for files).
- Large exports are processed asynchronously. You will receive an email with a download link when the export is ready.
- Download links expire after 7 days.

Partial Export:
- You can export individual projects from the project settings page.
- Export specific date ranges from Settings > Data > Custom Export.

Data Retention:
- Active accounts: Data is retained indefinitely.
- Cancelled accounts: Data is retained for 30 days after cancellation.
- Deleted projects: Recoverable from trash for 30 days.

GDPR Compliance:
- CloudDesk is GDPR compliant.
- Users can request a full data export (right of portability) via Settings > Privacy > Request Data Export.
- Users can request account deletion (right to erasure) via Settings > Privacy > Delete My Account.
- Data processing agreements (DPA) are available for Enterprise customers.

title: Integrations Guide
content:
CloudDesk Integrations

Available Integrations:

1. Slack
   - Receive notifications for project updates, task assignments, and mentions.
   - Create tasks directly from Slack messages.
   - Setup: Settings > Integrations > Slack > Connect.

2. Microsoft Teams
   - Similar functionality to Slack integration.
   - Supports Teams channels and direct messages.
   - Setup: Settings > Integrations > Microsoft Teams > Connect.

3. GitHub / GitLab
   - Link repositories to CloudDesk projects.
   - Automatically create tasks from issues.
   - Track pull request status within CloudDesk.
   - Setup: Settings > Integrations > GitHub > Connect.

4. Google Workspace
   - Sync Google Calendar events with CloudDesk tasks.
   - Attach Google Drive files to tasks.
   - Setup: Settings > Integrations > Google Workspace > Connect.

5. Zapier
   - Connect CloudDesk with 5,000+ apps through Zapier.
   - Popular automations: Create tasks from emails, sync with CRM, notify on completion.
   - Setup: Visit zapier.com and search for CloudDesk.

6. Jira (Enterprise only)
   - Two-way sync between Jira issues and CloudDesk tasks.
   - Map Jira fields to CloudDesk fields.
   - Setup: Settings > Integrations > Jira > Connect.

Custom Integrations:
- Use the CloudDesk API to build custom integrations.
- Webhook support for real-time event-driven integrations.

Troubleshooting:
- If an integration stops working, try disconnecting and reconnecting.
- Check that the third-party app has not revoked CloudDesk's access.
- Contact Support if issues persist.

title: Troubleshooting Login Issues
content:
CloudDesk Login Troubleshooting

Common Login Issues:

1. 'Invalid email or password' Error:
   - Verify that you are using the correct email address.
   - Check if Caps Lock is enabled.
   - Try resetting your password using the 'Forgot Password?' link.
   - Ensure you are logging into the correct workspace URL.

2. Account Locked:
   - Accounts are locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
   - Wait 30 minutes for automatic unlock, or contact Support for immediate unlock.
   - After unlock, use the 'Forgot Password?' link to reset your password.

3. Two-Factor Authentication Issues:
   - Ensure your authenticator app's time is synchronized.
   - If you lost your 2FA device, use one of your backup codes.
   - If you have no backup codes, contact Support with identity verification.

4. SSO Login Issues (Enterprise):
   - Verify your SSO provider (Okta, Azure AD) is configured correctly.
   - Check that your user account exists in the SSO directory.
   - Clear browser cookies and try again.
   - Contact your IT administrator if SSO is misconfigured.

5. Browser Issues:
   - CloudDesk supports the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.
   - Clear your browser cache and cookies.
   - Disable browser extensions that might interfere (ad blockers, privacy extensions).
   - Try using an incognito/private browsing window.

6. Session Expired:
   - CloudDesk sessions expire after 8 hours of inactivity.
   - Simply log in again to start a new session.
   - Enable 'Remember me' on trusted devices to extend the session to 30 days.

title: Invoice Management
content:
CloudDesk Invoice Management

Viewing Invoices:
- Go to Settings > Billing > Invoices to view all past invoices.
- Invoices are generated on each billing renewal date.
- Each invoice includes: plan details, user count, subtotal, taxes, and total amount.

Downloading Invoices:
- Click on any invoice to view and download it as a PDF.
- Bulk download is available: select multiple invoices and click 'Download Selected'.

Invoice Details:
- Invoice number (format: INV-YYYY-NNNN)
- Billing period
- Plan name and tier
- Number of users
- Per-user rate
- Subtotal
- Tax amount and tax ID
- Total amount
- Payment status (Paid, Pending, Failed)

Updating Billing Information:
- Update your billing address from Settings > Billing > Billing Address.
- Update your payment method from Settings > Billing > Payment Method.
- Changes to billing information apply to future invoices only.

Tax Exemption:
- If your organization is tax-exempt, upload your tax exemption certificate at Settings > Billing > Tax Settings.
- Tax exemption takes effect on the next invoice after verification (typically 1-3 business days).

Disputed Charges:
- If you believe a charge is incorrect, contact Support within 30 days of the invoice date.
- Provide the invoice number and a description of the dispute.
- CloudDesk will review and respond within 5 business days.

title: Supported Browsers and System Requirements
content:
CloudDesk System Requirements

Supported Browsers:
- Google Chrome (latest 2 versions)
- Mozilla Firefox (latest 2 versions)
- Microsoft Edge (latest 2 versions)
- Apple Safari (latest 2 versions)

Not Supported:
- Internet Explorer (any version)
- Opera Mini
- UC Browser

Minimum System Requirements:
- Screen resolution: 1280 x 720 (1920 x 1080 recommended)
- Internet connection: 1 Mbps minimum (5 Mbps recommended)
- JavaScript must be enabled
- Cookies must be enabled for authentication

Mobile Access:
- CloudDesk is accessible via mobile browsers with limited functionality.
- A native mobile app is planned but not yet available.
- Mobile browsers support viewing and commenting on tasks.

Accessibility:
- CloudDesk follows WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines.
- Screen reader support is available for major screen readers (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver).
- Keyboard navigation is fully supported.
- High contrast mode is available in Settings > Accessibility.

title: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
content:
CloudDesk Service Level Agreement

Uptime Guarantee:
- Starter and Professional plans: 99.9% uptime guarantee.
- Enterprise plan: 99.99% uptime guarantee with custom SLA terms.

Uptime Calculation:
- Uptime is calculated monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance windows.
- Scheduled maintenance is communicated at least 72 hours in advance via email and the status page.

Service Credits:
- If uptime falls below the guaranteed level, affected customers are eligible for service credits.
- 99.0%–99.9%: 10% credit
- 95.0%–99.0%: 25% credit
- Below 95.0%: 50% credit
- Credits are applied to the next billing period and do not exceed one month's charges.

Exclusions:
- Force majeure events
- Customer's internet connectivity issues
- Scheduled maintenance
- Beta features

Support Response Times:
- Starter: Email support, response within 24 hours.
- Professional: Priority support, response within 4 hours during business hours.
- Enterprise: Dedicated support, response within 1 hour, 24/7.

Status Page:
- Real-time service status is available at https://status.clouddesk.io.
- Subscribe to status updates via email or RSS.

title: Project Management Features
content:
CloudDesk Project Management

Projects:
- Create unlimited projects (subject to plan limits).
- Organize projects into folders and categories.
- Set project visibility: Public (all workspace members) or Private (invited members only).

Tasks:
- Create tasks within projects.
- Assign tasks to team members.
- Set due dates, priorities (Low, Medium, High, Urgent), and labels.
- Track task status: To Do, In Progress, Review, Done.
- Add subtasks for complex work items.
- Attach files (up to 100 MB per file, 10 GB total per project on Professional plan).

Views:
- List view: Traditional task list.
- Board view: Kanban-style drag-and-drop.
- Calendar view: Tasks organized by due date.
- Timeline view: Gantt-style project timeline (Professional and Enterprise).

Automation (Professional and Enterprise):
- Create custom automation rules.
- Examples: Auto-assign tasks based on labels, send notifications on status change, move tasks between projects.
- Automation templates are available for common workflows.

Templates:
- Save projects as templates for reuse.
- CloudDesk provides built-in templates for common project types: Software Development, Marketing Campaign, Product Launch, Customer Onboarding.

title: CloudDesk Rate Limits
content:
CloudDesk Rate Limits

API Rate Limits:
- Professional plan: 1,000 requests per minute per API key.
- Enterprise plan: 10,000 requests per minute per API key.
- Rate limits are applied per API key, not per user.

UI Rate Limits:
- CloudDesk does not impose hard rate limits on UI interactions.
- However, automated scripts or bots interacting with the UI may be blocked.

File Upload Limits:
- Maximum file size: 100 MB per file.
- Maximum total storage: Based on plan (50 GB Starter, 500 GB Professional, Unlimited Enterprise).
- Supported file types: All common file types. Executable files (.exe, .bat, .sh) are blocked.

Email Notification Limits:
- Maximum 100 email notifications per user per day.
- Users can configure notification preferences in Settings > Notifications.

Export Limits:
- Data exports are limited to one export per hour.
- Large exports (over 1 GB) may take up to 24 hours to process.

When Rate Limited:
- API responses will include a 429 status code.
- The Retry-After header indicates how many seconds to wait.
- Consistently hitting rate limits may result in temporary API key suspension.

title: Workspace Settings and Administration
content:
CloudDesk Workspace Administration

Workspace Settings:
- Workspace name and URL (slug) can be changed from Settings > General.
- URL changes take effect immediately; old URLs redirect for 30 days.

Branding (Enterprise):
- Custom logo and brand colors.
- Custom domain support (e.g., projects.yourcompany.com).
- White-label options available.

Security Settings:
- Enforce 2FA for all team members.
- Set password policies (minimum length, complexity, expiry).
- IP allowlisting for workspace access.
- Configure SSO/SAML providers.

Compliance:
- CloudDesk is SOC 2 Type II certified.
- GDPR compliant with DPA available.
- HIPAA BAA available for Enterprise Healthcare customers.
- Data residency options: US, EU, Asia-Pacific.

Audit Logs (Enterprise):
- View all workspace activity in Settings > Security > Audit Logs.
- Filter by user, action type, and date range.
- Export audit logs as CSV.
- Audit logs are retained for 1 year.

Deletion:
- Workspace deletion requires Owner confirmation and a 7-day waiting period.
- All data is permanently deleted after the waiting period.
- This action cannot be undone.

title: Notification Settings
content:
CloudDesk Notification Settings

Notification Channels:
1. In-App Notifications: Real-time notifications within CloudDesk.
2. Email Notifications: Sent to your registered email address.
3. Slack/Teams Notifications: If integrated, notifications can be routed to channels.
4. Mobile Push Notifications: Available when the mobile app launches.

Configurable Events:
- Task assigned to you
- Task status changed
- Mentioned in a comment
- Project shared with you
- Due date approaching (1 day, 3 days)
- Weekly digest

Do Not Disturb:
- Set quiet hours during which no notifications are sent.
- Configure from Settings > Notifications > Do Not Disturb.
- Default: Disabled.

Digest Mode:
- Instead of individual notifications, receive a daily or weekly summary.
- Configure from Settings > Notifications > Digest.

Muting:
- Mute notifications for specific projects or tasks.
- Right-click a project or task and select 'Mute Notifications'.

title: File Storage and Management
content:
CloudDesk File Storage

File Uploads:
- Attach files to tasks, projects, and comments.
- Drag and drop or use the file picker.
- Maximum file size: 100 MB per file.
- Supported: Documents, images, videos, archives, and most common file types.
- Blocked: Executable files (.exe, .bat, .sh, .cmd) for security.

Storage Limits:
- Starter: 50 GB total workspace storage.
- Professional: 500 GB total workspace storage.
- Enterprise: Unlimited storage.
- View storage usage at Settings > Storage.

File Versioning:
- CloudDesk keeps the last 10 versions of each file.
- View file history by clicking the version icon on any attached file.
- Restore previous versions at any time.

File Preview:
- Inline preview is supported for: Images (PNG, JPG, GIF, SVG), PDFs, Videos (MP4, WebM), and Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Other file types can be downloaded.

Sharing:
- Generate shareable links for files.
- Links can be set to expire after a specified time.
- Links can be password-protected.
- Revoke shared links at any time from the file settings.

title: CloudDesk Mobile Access
content:
CloudDesk Mobile Access

Current Status:
- CloudDesk does not currently have a native mobile app.
- A progressive web app (PWA) is available for mobile browsers.
- The PWA provides responsive access to core features.

PWA Installation:
- On iOS Safari: Tap the Share button > Add to Home Screen.
- On Android Chrome: Tap the three-dot menu > Add to Home Screen.

Mobile Features:
- View and comment on tasks
- View project status
- Receive push notifications (PWA)
- View and respond to messages
- Basic file viewing

Limitations on Mobile:
- File uploads are limited to 25 MB on mobile.
- Gantt/Timeline view is not available on mobile.
- Drag-and-drop is limited on mobile browsers.
- Some advanced settings pages may not be fully optimized.

Native App Roadmap:
- A native mobile app for iOS and Android is planned for Q1 2027.
- Beta testing will begin in Q4 2026.
- Sign up for the mobile beta at https://clouddesk.io/mobile-beta.

title: Keyboard Shortcuts
content:
CloudDesk Keyboard Shortcuts

Global:
- Cmd/Ctrl + K: Open command palette
- Cmd/Ctrl + N: Create new task
- Cmd/Ctrl + /: Toggle sidebar
- Cmd/Ctrl + .: Open settings
- Esc: Close modal or panel

Navigation:
- G then P: Go to Projects
- G then T: Go to Tasks
- G then I: Go to Inbox
- G then S: Go to Settings

Task Actions:
- E: Edit selected task
- D: Mark as Done
- A: Assign task
- L: Add label
- P: Set priority
- Delete/Backspace: Delete task (with confirmation)

Editor:
- Cmd/Ctrl + B: Bold
- Cmd/Ctrl + I: Italic
- Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + L: Bullet list
- Cmd/Ctrl + Enter: Save and close

View Shortcuts Reference:
- Press ? at any time to see the full keyboard shortcuts reference.

title: Contact Support
content:
Contacting CloudDesk Support

Support Channels:
1. In-App Chat: Available for Professional and Enterprise plans during business hours (Mon-Fri, 9 AM - 6 PM EST).
2. Email: support@clouddesk.io — Available for all plans.
3. Help Center: https://help.clouddesk.io — Self-service knowledge base.
4. Community Forum: https://community.clouddesk.io — Peer support and feature requests.
5. Phone Support: Enterprise only, available 24/7.

Response Times:
- Starter: Email within 24 hours.
- Professional: Email within 4 hours, chat within 15 minutes (business hours).
- Enterprise: Email within 1 hour, chat within 5 minutes, phone 24/7.

When Contacting Support:
Please provide:
- Your workspace name
- A description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce (if applicable)
- Screenshots or screen recordings
- Browser and OS version
- Any error messages

Escalation:
- If your issue is not resolved within the expected response time, you can escalate by replying to the support email with 'ESCALATE' in the subject line.
- Enterprise customers can contact their dedicated account manager directly.
